page.layout: One column of index entries with page numbers at the right; a large initial "D" woodcut-style heading below the column. Running head "INDEX" centred at the top.

main_text.l: Cyprinus coelus ut in multos dies duret | 497
main_text.head: D.

page.notes: Printed page is an index page (Index heading, alphabetical entries C–D). The "D" at the bottom is a large decorative initial, transcribed as a letter. The entry "Conuiuiatio amicitiarum conciliatrix honestissima" breaks at the line end with a printed hyphen, so it is joined as "honestis-sima" in the source. Several entries have uncertain letterforms (long s and f, "Caculus" possibly "Caeculus", "Cuniculi" possibly "Cuniculi"), and the page-number "433" and the final "Dolor" line are hard to read; numbers and the last line should be checked against the scan. The final "Dolor" line has no page number visible.
